weekly_archive.description: Goldman Sachs late Friday became the last of the major banks to retract its forecast of no rate hike next week.

weekly_archive.title: Quantum-proof blockchain: why math, not machines, holds the key
weekly_archive.description: lockchains don’t need quantum computers to be quantum-safe, argues Optimum co-founder and MIT professor Muriel Médard. Classic math already gives us the tools.
weekly_archive.summary: A leading MIT professor argues blockchains can achieve quantum safety using existing mathematical tools, not future quantum computers. The approach relies on hash-based signatures, which are already considered resistant to quantum attacks.

weekly_archive.title: Fed, BOE, BOJ interest-rate decisions: Crypto Week Ahead
weekly_archive.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Sept. 14.
weekly_archive.summary: Central bank rate decisions from the Fed, BOE, and BOJ this week could drive volatility across crypto markets as traders position around shifts in global liquidity and risk appetite. Higher-for-longer rates tend to pressure risk assets including Bitcoin and altcoins, while any dovish pivot could spark a relief rally. The week starting Sept. 14 is being closely watched for how these policy moves shape short-term crypto price action.

weekly_archive.title: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
weekly_archive.description: Eight banking groups on Monday said they want tighter limits on stablecoin rewards, keeping the ongoing banks-versus-crypto dispute alive in Congress.
weekly_archive.summary: Eight banking groups are pressuring the Senate to impose tighter limits on stablecoin rewards ahead of a planned Clarity Act vote, escalating a long-running dispute between traditional finance and the crypto industry. The outcome could directly affect stablecoin yields and the competitive dynamics between bank deposits and crypto-based dollar tokens.

weekly_archive.title: Here is the revised Clarity Act ethics provision Donald Trump has agreed to
weekly_archive.description: The new Clarity Act draft would force divestiture and give state attorneys general the ability to sue to enforce the ethics provision.
weekly_archive.summary: Donald Trump has agreed to a revised Clarity Act ethics provision that would require him to divest from any crypto or digital asset interests. The new draft also empowers state attorneys general to sue to enforce the ethics rules, adding a notable enforcement mechanism to the proposed legislation.

weekly_archive.title: Even if Clarity fails, Wall Street’s crypto push is unlikely to stop
weekly_archive.description: The Clarity Act could give banks, brokers and asset managers a clearer rulebook, but financial firms have already moved far enough into digital assets that failure may slow adoption rather than stop it.
weekly_archive.summary: Wall Street’s crypto expansion is unlikely to stop even if the Clarity Act fails, though its passage could accelerate adoption by clarifying rules for banks, brokers, and asset managers. Without the legislation, institutional progress may slow but is already too advanced to reverse.
